description: Runs URL inspection for up to 50 URLs of one property and returns a compact table of which are indexed, their coverage state, last crawl and the problems found. Each URL uses one of the 2,000 daily inspections per property.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language for Google's issue messages, for example "en-US" (default) or "el".

site_url.description: Search Console property, for example "sc-domain:example.com" or "https://www.example.com/". A bare domain or any page URL on the site also works. Optional when GSC_SITE_URL is set or the account has exactly one property.

urls.description: The full URLs to inspect, all on the same property.

name: inspect_urls
title: Inspect several URLs
